newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bourse kerb bond deals - November 13.
newsitem.headline: Polish bourse kerb bond deals - November 13.

text.p: Turnover in kerb trade through the Warsaw bourse was at 3.7 million zlotys on Wednesday.
The following is a summary of the day's block transactions on the Warsaw bourse.
* 1,550 variable-interest 10-year bonds maturing on July 18, 2006, traded at 99.65 zlotys.
* Two blocks of 500 variable-interest 10-year bonds maturing on October 12, 2006, traded at 99.6 zlotys.
* Two blocks of 527 fixed-interest two-year bonds maturing on October 12, 1998, traded at 94 zlotys.
